headline: Hungary Online Retail Market Surpasses 100 Million Orders, Reaching 2.5% of GDP
summary: Hungary's e-commerce market reached a record 100 million orders, generating over HUF 2.1 trillion (€5.6 billion) in annual revenue to represent 2.5% of national GDP.
why: E-commerce data serves as an key index for monitoring Hungarian consumer spending and retail trade.
